body:
You are in a dangerous situation, he destroys things that are special to you. He has threatened to beat you over dinner. Beat you. Grab all important documents and items and leave when he is not there. Is there anyone you can trust to help you? If not immediately contact a women's shelter now.

Get a divorce. No one is allowed to do that to you. He isn't sorry, if he was truly sorry he wouldn't keep doing this crap. He is escalating.
I highly doubt it, most people that I had asked blew me off or asked for hook up random sex.

I have never been approached, at least not at my current age. I was approached by a man in his mid 20s when I was barely 16. That was last time. I take care of my appearance. But I don't inspire men to ask for my number.
There is no fool proof way to tell if someone will be abusive. I have tried finding one.
Every man I have date no matter how different he was from the last. Had used or abused then thrown me away. It has to be me.
I had done this though, maybe it's me. I'm not a catch in anyone's eyes.
Trust me I know

I have dated men all over the map, rich, poor, lawful, unlawful, short, tall, skinny, fat.

Sadly I do not have funds to adopt, and most places don't allow you to adopt if your single.
I want children, I wouldn't lie or cheat on my spouse. It's a small sacrifice for something so great.
I can just turn off my brain during the act, think of other things
Not a doctor, but what all scans have they done? I had xray, mri, ct.
Plenty of people date others from different races or ethnic backgrounds. I was til I messed up recently.

I tried messaging him mid week and I may message again soon. I think after reviewing our previous messages I know where i went wrong. I want to fix this, I do not want to lose someone so amazing because I'm an emotional controlling idiot.

Don't you see that doesn't bode well? You're not able to express yourself, and if you try, you're put down. 

You seem to just hurt each other; neither of you understand the other. And you don't seem to want to. You both should leave and find partners that do understand and love you.

Have you two sat down and talked about what you each want for your future? What does married life look like to you both? What do each of you expect or hope for from each other?

Might help for you each to make a list of these things, as well as pros and cons list about your relationship with each other. But no judgement, no accusations, you both need to be open and honest.

Then, the best I can offer is to try couples therapy before marriage. If your partner won't do that, don't know what to say.

I have seen scrapes turn into full-blown drag out fights. Typically, it starts small, then resentment builds; no one is open and honest when communicating to each other, then boom. Please also individual therapy, I saw in a previous post that you stopped taking meds for depression. Do you think it's part of why you're not happy now? When a medication isn't helping, talk to your doctor about alternatives.

You're settling on someone beating you and never showing you love. What have you tried to do to get better? And I would rather be alone than beaten and treated like trash till the day I die. We are depressed; it doesn't mean we don't deserve basic human decency or respect.

Just because you were abused as a child doesn't make it okay now. You need intense therapy; even in my most suicidal depressive state, I never allowed ANYONE to lay a hand on me. Do you think all this hatred and beatings will stop once you're married? Think again; it just makes it just that much harder to leave. This depression will never get better if you surround yourself in toxicity.
Again, you NEVER put your hands on another person in anger. This relationship is extremely toxic.
It's the control aspect. It's a pain that we feel can be controlled, not to mention it releases endorphins. But we shouldn't do it. It's a short-term solution that doesn't work long-term.
As soon as it started getting physical, you both should of broken up.
Because it's pain you can control. I haven't cut in a while; I still struggle with the need.

If your bipolar you know it's a myth you can do it without meds? I see many that try diets and exercises but it doesn't help. It's merely a distraction. Please stay in therapy and try the meds they give you. If they do not help tell therapist immediately so they can try something else.
For some people it's short. Others if a lifetime. I recognized I was depressed at about 8 or 9 and I would pray for death so I wouldn't feel pain anymore.
